verses.original: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְחֻקֹּתָ֧יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֛יו וּמִצְוֺתָ֖יו כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·haḇ·tā ’êṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·šā·mar·tā miš·mar·tōw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ū·miš·pā·ṭāw ū·miṣ·wō·ṯāw kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always . . . keep His charge His statutes His ordinances and His commandments
verses.literalPt: AMARÁS, pois, ao SENHOR teu Deus, e guardarás as suas ordenanças, e os seus estatutos, e os seus juízos, e os seus mandamentos, todos os dias.

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֮ הַיּוֹם֒ כִּ֣י׀ לֹ֣א אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יָדְעוּ֙ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ רָא֔וּ אֶת־ מוּסַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת־ גָּדְל֕וֹ אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּזְרֹע֖וֹ הַנְּטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem hay·yō·wm kî lō ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū wa·’ă·šer lō- rā·’ū ’eṯ- mū·sar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’eṯ- gā·ḏə·lōw ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ha·ḥă·zā·qāh ū·zə·rō·‘ōw han·nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Know this day that it is not your children who . . . have known and . . . seen the discipline of the LORD your God His greatness His mighty hand and His outstretched arm
verses.literalPt: E hoje sabereis que falo, não com vossos filhos, que o não sabem, e não viram a instrução do SENHOR vosso Deus, a sua grandeza, a sua mão forte, e o seu braço estendido;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֹֽתֹתָיו֙ וְאֶֽת־ מַעֲשָׂ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם וּלְכָל־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ō·ṯō·ṯāw wə·’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bə·ṯō·wḵ miṣ·rā·yim lə·p̄ar·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim ū·lə·ḵāl- ’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: the signs and works He did in Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and all his land
verses.literalPt: Nem tampouco os seus sinais, nem os seus feitos, que fez no meio do Egito a Faraó, rei do Egito, e a toda a sua terra;

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְחֵ֨יל מִצְרַ֜יִם לְסוּסָ֣יו וּלְרִכְבּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵצִ֜יף אֶת־ מֵ֤י יַם־ סוּף֙ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם בְּרָדְפָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְאַבְּדֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·ḥêl miṣ·ra·yim lə·sū·sāw ū·lə·riḵ·bōw ’ă·šer hê·ṣîp̄ ’eṯ- mê yam- sūp̄ ‘al- pə·nê·hem bə·rā·ḏə·p̄ām ’a·ḥă·rê·ḵem way·’ab·bə·ḏêm Yah·weh ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: what He did to the Egyptian army and horses and chariots when He made the waters of the Red Sea engulf - them as they pursued you . . . and how He destroyed them completely even to this day . . .
verses.literalPt: Nem o que fez ao exército dos egípcios, aos seus cavalos e aos seus carros, fazendo passar sobre eles as águas do Mar Vermelho quando vos perseguiam, e como o SENHOR os destruiu, até ao dia de hoje;

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר עַד־ בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lā·ḵem bam·miḏ·bār ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵem ‘aḏ- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: what He did for you in the wilderness until you reached . . . this place
verses.literalPt: Nem o que vos fez no deserto, até que chegastes a este lugar;

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְדָתָ֣ן וְלַאֲבִירָ֗ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָב֮ בֶּן־ רְאוּבֵן֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּצְתָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־ פִּ֔יהָ וַתִּבְלָעֵ֥ם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ אָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם בְּקֶ֖רֶב כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·ḏā·ṯān wə·la·’ă·ḇî·rām bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ben- rə·’ū·ḇên ’ă·šer pā·ṣə·ṯāh hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- pî·hā wat·tiḇ·lā·‘êm wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê·hem wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- hay·qūm ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lê·hem bə·qe·reḇ kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and what He did in the midst of all the Israelites to Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab the Reubenite . . . when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them their households their tents and every living thing that belonged to them
verses.literalPt: E o que fez a Datã e a Abirão, filhos de Eliabe, filho de Rúben; como a terra abriu a sua boca e os tragou com as suas casas e com as suas tendas, como também tudo o que subsistia, e lhes pertencia, no meio de todo o Israel;

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֶת־ כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַגָּדֹ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ê·nê·ḵem hā·rō·’ōṯ ’eṯ- kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh Yah·weh hag·gā·ḏōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: For it is your own eyes that have seen every great work that the LORD has done
verses.literalPt: Porquanto os vossos olhos são os que viram toda a grande obra que fez o SENHOR.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm lə·ma·‘an te·ḥez·qū ū·ḇā·ṯem wî·riš·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: You shall therefore keep every commandment I am giving you today . . . so that you may have the strength to go in and possess the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess
verses.literalPt: Guardai, pois, todos os mandamentos que eu vos ordeno hoje, para que sejais fortes, e entreis, e ocupeis a terra que passais a possuir;

verses.original: וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֛ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם וּלְזַרְעָ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ma·‘an ta·’ă·rî·ḵū yā·mîm ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem ū·lə·zar·‘ām ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: and so that you may live long . . . in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give them and their descendants a land flowing with milk and honey
verses.literalPt: E para que prolongueis os dias na terra que o SENHOR jurou dar a vossos pais e à sua descendência, terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה בָא־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ לֹ֣א כְאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ הִ֔וא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצָאתֶ֖ם מִשָּׁ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּזְרַע֙ אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֔ וְהִשְׁקִ֥יתָ בְרַגְלְךָ֖ כְּגַ֥ן הַיָּרָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: kî hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh lō ḵə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim hî ’ă·šer yə·ṣā·ṯem miš·šām ’ă·šer tiz·ra‘ ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā wə·hiš·qî·ṯā ḇə·raḡ·lə·ḵā kə·ḡan hay·yā·rāq
verses.literal: For the land that you are entering . . . to possess is not like the land of Egypt from which you have come . . . where you sowed your seed and irrigated on foot like a vegetable garden
verses.literalPt: Porque a terra que passas a possuir não é como a terra do Egito, de onde saíste, em que semeavas a tua semente, e a regavas com o teu pé, como a uma horta.

verses.original: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ אֶ֥רֶץ הָרִ֖ים וּבְקָעֹ֑ת לִמְטַ֥ר הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם תִּשְׁתֶּה־ מָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm šām·māh lə·riš·tāh ’e·reṣ hā·rîm ū·ḇə·qā·‘ōṯ lim·ṭar haš·šā·ma·yim tiš·teh- mā·yim
verses.literal: But the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks in . . . the rain from heaven
verses.literalPt: Mas a terra que passais a possuir é terra de montes e de vales; da chuva dos céus beberá as águas;

verses.original: אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ דֹּרֵ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ תָּמִ֗יד עֵינֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ מֵֽרֵשִׁית֙ הַשָּׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד אַחֲרִ֥ית שָׁנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā dō·rêš ’ō·ṯāh tā·mîḏ ‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bāh mê·rê·šîṯ haš·šā·nāh wə·‘aḏ ’a·ḥă·rîṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: It is a land for which the LORD your God cares the eyes of the LORD your God are always on it from the beginning to the end . . . of the year
verses.literalPt: Terra de que o SENHOR teu Deus tem cuidado; os olhos do SENHOR teu Deus estão sobre ela continuamente, desde o princípio até ao fim do ano.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־ מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעָבְד֔וֹ בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכָל־ נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·mō·a‘ tiš·mə·‘ū ’el- miṣ·wō·ṯay ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ū·lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏōw bə·ḵāl lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šə·ḵem
verses.literal: So if you carefully obey . . . . . . the commandments I am giving you today - to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul
verses.literalPt: E será que, se diligentemente obedecerdes a meus mandamentos que hoje vos ordeno, de amar ao SENHOR vosso Deus, e de o servir de todo o vosso coração e de toda a vossa alma,

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־ אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî mə·ṭar- ’ar·ṣə·ḵem bə·‘it·tōw yō·w·reh ū·mal·qō·wōš wə·’ā·sap̄·tā ḏə·ḡā·ne·ḵā wə·ṯî·rō·šə·ḵā wə·yiṣ·hā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: then I will provide rain for your land in season the autumn and spring rains . . . that you may gather your grain new wine and oil
verses.literalPt: Então darei a chuva da vossa terra a seu tempo, a temporã e a serôdia, para que recolhais o vosso grão, e o vosso mosto e o vosso azeite.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ‘ê·śeḇ bə·śā·ḏə·ḵā liḇ·hem·te·ḵā wə·’ā·ḵal·tā wə·śā·ḇā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: And I will provide grass in the fields for your livestock and you will eat and be satisfied
verses.literalPt: E darei erva no teu campo aos teus animais, e comerás, e fartar-te-ás.

verses.original: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mə·rū lā·ḵem pen yip̄·teh lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·sar·tem wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯem lā·hem
verses.literal: But be careful that you are not enticed . . . to turn aside to worship and bow down to other gods
verses.literalPt: Guardai-vos, que o vosso coração não se engane, e vos desvieis, e sirvais a outros deuses, e vos inclineis perante eles;

verses.original: וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־ יְהוָ֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·rāh ’ap̄- Yah·weh bā·ḵem wə·‘ā·ṣar ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·lō- yih·yeh mā·ṭār wə·hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lō ṯit·tên ’eṯ- yə·ḇū·lāh wa·’ă·ḇaḏ·tem mə·hê·rāh mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭō·ḇāh ’ă·šer Yah·weh nō·ṯên lā·ḵem
verses.literal: or the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you He will shut the heavens so that there will be no rain nor will the land yield its produce and you will soon perish . . . from the good land that the LORD is giving you
verses.literalPt: E a ira do SENHOR se acenda contra vós, e feche ele os céus, e não haja água, e a terra não dê o seu fruto, e cedo pereçais da boa terra que o SENHOR vos dá.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־ יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tem ’eṯ- də·ḇā·ray ’êl·leh ‘al- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·‘al- nap̄·šə·ḵem ū·qə·šar·tem ’ō·ṯām lə·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yeḏ·ḵem wə·hā·yū lə·ṭō·w·ṭā·p̄ōṯ bên ‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them . . . on your foreheads . . .
verses.literalPt: Ponde, pois, estas minhas palavras no vosso coração e na vossa alma, e atai-as por sinal na vossa mão, para que estejam por frontais entre os vossos olhos.

verses.original: וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lim·maḏ·tem ’ō·ṯām ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem lə·ḏab·bêr bām bə·šiḇ·tə·ḵā bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇə·leḵ·tə·ḵā ḇad·de·reḵ ū·ḇə·šā·ḵə·bə·ḵā ū·ḇə·qū·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Teach them to your children speaking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road when you lie down and when you get up
verses.literalPt: E ensinai-as a vossos filhos, falando delas assentado em tua casa, e andando pelo caminho, e deitando-te, e levantando-te;

verses.original: וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־ מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ṯaḇ·tām ‘al- mə·zū·zō·wṯ bê·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇiš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates
verses.literalPt: E escreve-as nos umbrais de tua casa, e nas tuas portas;

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yir·bū yə·mê·ḵem wî·mê ḇə·nê·ḵem ‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem kî·mê haš·šā·ma·yim ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: so that as long as the heavens are above the earth your days and those of your children may be multiplied in the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers
verses.literalPt: Para que se multipliquem os vossos dias e os dias de vossos filhos na terra que o SENHOR jurou a vossos pais dar-lhes, como os dias dos céus sobre a terra.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אִם־ שָׁמֹ֨ר תִּשְׁמְר֜וּן אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָ֑הּ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם לָלֶ֥כֶת בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָ֖יו וּלְדָבְקָה־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- šā·mōr tiš·mə·rūn ’eṯ- kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem la·‘ă·śō·ṯāh lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw ū·lə·ḏā·ḇə·qāh- ḇōw
verses.literal: For if you carefully keep . . . all these commandments I am giving you to follow to love the LORD your God to walk in all His ways and to hold fast to Him
verses.literalPt: Porque se diligentemente guardardes todos estes mandamentos, que vos ordeno para os guardardes, amando ao SENHOR vosso Deus, andando em todos os seus caminhos, e a ele vos achegardes,

verses.original: וְהוֹרִ֧ישׁ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·rîš Yah·weh ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh mil·lip̄·nê·ḵem wî·riš·tem gō·w·yim gə·ḏō·lîm wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm mik·kem
verses.literal: then the LORD will drive out all these nations before you and you will dispossess nations greater and stronger than you
verses.literalPt: Também o SENHOR, de diante de vós, lançará fora todas estas nações, e possuireis nações maiores e mais poderosas do que vós.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף־ רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה מִן־ הַמִּדְבָּ֨ר וְהַלְּבָנ֜וֹן מִן־ הַנָּהָ֣ר נְהַר־ פְּרָ֗ת וְעַד֙ הַיָּ֣ם הָֽאַחֲר֔וֹן יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer tiḏ·rōḵ kap̄- raḡ·lə·ḵem bōw lā·ḵem yih·yeh min- ham·miḏ·bār wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn min- han·nā·hār nə·har- pə·rāṯ wə·‘aḏ hay·yām hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn yih·yeh gə·ḇul·ḵem
verses.literal: Every place where the sole of your foot treads will be yours Your territory will extend from the wilderness to Lebanon and from the Euphrates River . . . to the Western Sea
verses.literalPt: Todo o lugar que pisar a planta do vosso pé será vosso; desde o deserto, e desde o Líbano, desde o rio, o rio Eufrates, até ao mar ocidental, será o vosso termo.

verses.original: לֹא־ יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִ֖ישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם פַּחְדְּכֶ֨ם וּמֽוֹרַאֲכֶ֜ם יִתֵּ֣ן׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י כָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדְרְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ’îš bip̄·nê·ḵem paḥ·də·ḵem ū·mō·w·ra·’ă·ḵem yit·tên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer tiḏ·rə·ḵū- ḇāh ka·’ă·šer dib·ber lā·ḵem
verses.literal: No man will be able to stand against you the LORD your God will put the fear and dread of you upon all the land wherever you set foot as He has promised you
verses.literalPt: Ninguém resistirá diante de vós; o SENHOR vosso Deus porá sobre toda a terra, que pisardes, o vosso terror e o temor de vós, como já vos tem dito.

verses.original: רְאֵ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם בְּרָכָ֖ה וּקְלָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ṯên lip̄·nê·ḵem hay·yō·wm bə·rā·ḵāh ū·qə·lā·lāh
verses.literal: See today I am setting before you a blessing and a curse
verses.literalPt: Eis que hoje eu ponho diante de vós a bênção e a maldição;

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַבְּרָכָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְע֗וּ אֶל־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ’ă·šer tiš·mə·‘ū ’el- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: a blessing if you obey . . . the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you today
verses.literalPt: A bênção, quando cumprirdes os mandamentos do SENHOR vosso Deus, que hoje vos mando;

verses.original: וְהַקְּלָלָ֗ה אִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־ הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qə·lā·lāh ’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū ’el- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·sar·tem min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏa‘·tem
verses.literal: but a curse if you disobey . . . the commandments of the LORD your God and turn aside from the path I command you today by following . . . other gods which you have not known
verses.literalPt: Porém a maldição, se não cumprirdes os mandamentos do SENHOR vosso Deus, e vos desviardes do caminho que hoje vos ordeno, para seguirdes outros deuses que não conhecestes.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֶת־ הַבְּרָכָה֙ עַל־ הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים וְאֶת־ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה עַל־ הַ֥ר עֵיבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî yə·ḇî·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ‘al- har gə·ri·zîm wə·’eṯ- haq·qə·lā·lāh ‘al- har ‘ê·ḇāl
verses.literal: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering . . . to possess you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal
verses.literalPt: E será que, quando o SENHOR teu Deus te introduzir na terra, a que vais para possuí-la, então pronunciarás a bênção sobre o monte Gerizim, e a maldição sobre o monte Ebal.

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ הֵ֜מָּה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן אַֽחֲרֵי֙ דֶּ֚רֶךְ מְב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּעֲרָבָ֑ה מ֚וּל הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל אֵ֖צֶל אֵלוֹנֵ֥י מֹרֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- hêm·māh bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên ’a·ḥă·rê de·reḵ mə·ḇō·w haš·še·meš bə·’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hay·yō·šêḇ bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh mūl hag·gil·gāl ’ê·ṣel ’ê·lō·w·nê mō·reh
verses.literal: Are not these mountains across the Jordan west of the road toward the sunset in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah opposite Gilgal near the Oak of Moreh
verses.literalPt: Porventura não estão eles além do Jordão, junto ao caminho do pôr do sol, na terra dos cananeus, que habitam na campina defronte de Gilgal, junto aos carvalhais de Moré?

verses.original: כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖הּ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên lā·ḇō lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem nō·ṯên lā·ḵem wî·riš·tem ’ō·ṯāh wî·šaḇ·tem- bāh
verses.literal: For you are about to cross the Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you When you take possession of it and settle in it
verses.literalPt: Porque passareis o Jordão para entrardes a possuir a terra, que vos dá o SENHOR vosso Deus; e a possuireis, e nela habitareis.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’êṯ kāl- ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ṯên lip̄·nê·ḵem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: be careful to follow all the statutes and ordinances that I am setting before you today
verses.literalPt: Tende, pois, cuidado em cumprir todos os estatutos e os juízos, que eu hoje vos proponho.
